subject: 9mmhandgun
label: 9mmhandgun, in the place of the game's models/v_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/p_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/w_9mmhandgun.mdl

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_grenade.mdl, models/w_satchel.mdl, models/w_357.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: The brief asks for a 9mm semi-automatic pistol. The outline is a flat rectangular slab in every view (front, side, top, below and the four corner views). It has no slide, barrel, grip or trigger guard, so it does not read as a pistol in any view.

M2.reason: The brief gives no size, so 2 cannot be reached. Measured 20.9 x 5.9 x 21.2 units: a square footprint about 21 by 21 with a thin 6-unit height. A pistol is long and narrow, so the proportions are clearly off.

M3.reason: The brief's parts are missing: slide, barrel, frame, grip, trigger guard, trigger, hammer, magazine and sights. The asset is one closed box (12 triangles) in the front, side, top and corner views, with no part on it.

M4.reason: The brief asks for black and grey polymer and steel. The whole asset is one even mid-grey (front, back and top views) with no black polymer grip or frame and no separate steel slide. The grey is in the right family, but the black region is missing.

M5.reason: The brief names no markings, but a pistol would show slide serrations, a grip texture and trigger detail. The surface has only a faint blotchy noise (top and below views), with no panel lines or grip texture.

M6.reason: In the line-up (A, beside the grenade, satchel and .357) the asset is a flat grey slab with no outline of a weapon. A player would not take it for a Half-Life model; it is the most obviously unlike object of the four.

M7.reason: The brief gives no facing, and the box has no front. It lies flat as a slab (side views show it lying on its underside), so it is upright only in the trivial sense. Nothing shows which way a pistol would face.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. The box is closed with no open, inside-out or floating faces, and at 12 triangles it is far under the weapon pool's limit.

W1.reason: In first-person.png (left panel) the block sits roughly where the game's pistol sits, low on the right-hand side of the view, and it follows the hand through the attack frames (shoot 0 to 14) without leaving it. But it is a slab held by its bottom edge, with no grip or barrel direction, so it cannot be held the same way round as a pistol.
